## Teacher overview {.unnumbered}

Include pathway, expectations, prerequisites, preparation, materials, safety controls, timing, misconceptions, accommodations, and evidence to assess.

## Answer and evidence guide {.unnumbered}

For calculations, show the schematic first, then givens and unknowns tables, general and substituted equations, units, full precision, final significant figures, a teacher note explaining the precision, and a plain-language interpretation.

## Verification and physical lab {.unnumbered}

Separate student prediction from teacher-prepared conditions. Never instruct students to create shorts, invent hardware faults, open a PSU, or probe inside an energized computer.
